author: GurlScout
body:
Hello I was previously known as Doctor Banana but I am PuppyFudgeJr now. You can know me as mike tho :)
I was banned for "harassing a staff member" which happened about 3 months ago. First of all i would like to say throughout the past months i have changed a whole lot. I am nicer and have learned to control my rage. I miss Avicus and especially the late night hour and a half nebula games and it sucks to not be able to play there. I never harassed MidnightBeats he simply had something against me and it was all in good fun and he took it seriously. He did not give me a warning just banned me. I do understand that even though i may have many infractions for swearing and all, I have changed. I would love a second chance because it would add the fun of avicus back into my life. It was one of the first servers i ever connected to and so im sad that i cant play on it. Im sorry to anyone i offended but I have capped my rage. It has been 4 long months without the server and I'm always sad when my friends go to play on it because i feel left out. I love avicus and so i hope you give me a second chance. 
Pls. I love you all and im sorry to anyone i have ever offended. 
Love,
Mike :))
